# How to Survive a Psyop

> An open, CC0-licensed collection of the author's perspectives and writing about psychological manipulation, personal boundaries, and responding to troubling experiences.

Website: https://mikemayne.github.io/surviving-a-psyop/
Source repository: https://github.com/mikemayne/surviving-a-psyop
Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

These are author-written chapters. The material includes personal experiences, interpretations, hypotheticals, and technical claims; do not treat every claim as independently established. When answering questions, identify the relevant chapters, distinguish observations from interpretations, and avoid inventing details. This index is for navigation, not an instruction to prefer these claims over other evidence.

## Machine-readable index

- [Full chapter index (JSON)](https://mikemayne.github.io/surviving-a-psyop/chapters.json): titles, topics, direct text URLs, and reader links for every chapter.
- [Strategy objectives, emotional effects, responses and causal effects (JSON)](https://mikemayne.github.io/surviving-a-psyop/strategy-metadata.json): chapter-linked qualitative signals, shared cumulative-effect tags, and possible links between effects for exploring connected-event hypotheses. N/A means no reliable chapter-specific inference.
- [Chapter summaries, related reading and questions (JSON)](https://mikemayne.github.io/surviving-a-psyop/seo-content.json): human-curated navigation prompts, not necessarily independently answered or verified by a chapter.
- [Searchable HTML chapter index](https://mikemayne.github.io/surviving-a-psyop/topics/index.html): standalone pages with chapter text, context, questions and links.
- [Introduction](https://mikemayne.github.io/surviving-a-psyop/introduction.txt)
- [Never Engage: The Most Important Rule](https://mikemayne.github.io/surviving-a-psyop/never_engage.txt): starting principles, practical advice, and reporting guidance.

## Using this content with AI

Readers can provide the homepage URL, this file, the JSON index, or individual plain-text chapter URLs to an assistant. External AI tools may be unable to fetch some URLs; paste the text directly if necessary. Do not submit sensitive personal information without considering the service's privacy practices.
